posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Guess that just means your friend's PC is even worse? Using 3D in RPG maker has always been an FPS nightmare, and the more you add to any given maps, the more it will happen. And that's not even considering any actual gameplay or perhaps just poorly made events/code. In your video you're just running around an empty map.
The only thing you can do, is slap fairly high PC specs as system requirements and hope for the best. There's no patch and no plugin for 3D to suddenly make it not suck.
Godot is literally free, and you can use all your RM assets in other engine these days, so that really the only thing one can recommend here.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
SGHarlekin said:
Godot is literally free, and you can use all your RM assets in other engine these days,
Click to expand...
I love Free Open Source Software but Godot isn't "great" at 3D either, just "servicable", and requires you to know how to code. Unfortunately it's either Unity or Unreal for performance and features in the 3D realm.
RPG Maker as a whole isn't the best for performance. It's fine for the kind of games it's built for (menu-based RPG combat and simple exploration) or things where there's not a lot of processing but you will see framerate drops trying to do too many things at once or processor-intensive things like lighting, pathfinding or 3D rendering.

posts.author: KermexRPG
posts.body: Sorry but RPG Maker MV is not a 3D engine. Yeah I know about that plugin but in my opinion that is just an interesting experiment, nothing more. What are the specs of your friend's pc? The problem can be a very outdated CPU or GPU, RPG Maker is single threaded that means you need good single core performance if you wanna get decent performance.
